name: Selection State
expression:
VAR _Mode = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'DateMode'[mode], "ALL" )
VAR _ModeIsAmbiguous = ISFILTERED ( 'DateMode' ) && NOT HASONEVALUE ( 'DateMode'[mode] )
VAR _Start = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'DateStart'[Date] )
VAR _End = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'DateEnd'[Date] )
RETURN
    SWITCH ( TRUE (),
        [Import State] <> "AVAILABLE", [Import State],
        _ModeIsAmbiguous || NOT ( _Mode IN { "ALL", "INTERVAL", "MISSING" } ), "INVALID_DATE_MODE",
        _Mode = "INTERVAL" && ( NOT HASONEVALUE ( 'DateStart'[Date] ) || NOT HASONEVALUE ( 'DateEnd'[Date] ) || _Start >= _End ), "INVALID_DATE_INTERVAL",
        "AVAILABLE"
    )
description: Single date mode; INTERVAL requires single start/end and uses [start,end). Inactive date bounds are ignored.

name: Supplier Selection State
expression:
IF ( ISFILTERED ( 'SupplierFocus' ) && NOT HASONEVALUE ( 'SupplierFocus'[supplier_sk] ),
        "MULTIPLE_SUPPLIER_SELECTION", "AVAILABLE" )
description: A missing focus means all reference contracts; multiple focuses are invalid.

name: Policy State
expression:
VAR _Version = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'publication_metadata'[policy_version] )
VAR _Digest = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'publication_metadata'[policy_sha256] )
RETURN
    SWITCH ( TRUE (),
        ISBLANK ( _Version ) || ISBLANK ( _Digest ), "POLICY_UNCONFIGURED",
        _Version <> "gold-hhi-policy-v1" || _Digest <> "eabc877d527133dd89f5184f77add49ddba56fcb2e82949bf31d658df66789f4", "POLICY_MISMATCH",
        "AVAILABLE"
    )
description: Binds the reviewed gold-hhi-policy-v1 digest before applying its 100% count/value minima; no silent threshold fallback.

name: Contract Count
expression:
VAR _Mode = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'DateMode'[mode], "ALL" )
VAR _Start = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'DateStart'[Date] )
VAR _End = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'DateEnd'[Date] )
VAR _Reference =
    FILTER (
        CALCULATETABLE ( 'mart_contract_detail', REMOVEFILTERS ( 'dim_supplier' ) ),
        _Mode = "ALL"
            || ( _Mode = "MISSING" && ISBLANK ( 'mart_contract_detail'[signing_date] ) )
            || ( _Mode = "INTERVAL" && NOT ISBLANK ( 'mart_contract_detail'[signing_date] )
                && 'mart_contract_detail'[signing_date] >= _Start && 'mart_contract_detail'[signing_date] < _End )
    )

RETURN
    IF ( [Selection State] = "AVAILABLE", COALESCE ( COUNTROWS ( SUMMARIZE ( _Reference, 'mart_contract_detail'[contract_key] ) ), 0 ) )
description: Distinct reference contracts; ignores connected supplier dimension only. Empty selection is zero.

name: Contract Value COP
expression:
VAR _Mode = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'DateMode'[mode], "ALL" )
VAR _Start = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'DateStart'[Date] )

                && 'mart_contract_detail'[signing_date] >= _Start && 'mart_contract_detail'[signing_date] < _End )

RETURN

name: HHI State
expression:
SWITCH ( TRUE (),
        [Import State] <> "AVAILABLE", [Import State],
        [Selection State] <> "AVAILABLE", [Selection State],
        [Policy State] <> "AVAILABLE", [Policy State],
        [Contract Count] = 0, "NO_CONTRACTS",
        NOT HASONEVALUE ( 'dim_entity'[entity_sk] ), "ENTITY_SELECTION_REQUIRED",
        SELECTEDVALUE ( 'dim_entity'[member_status] ) <> "KNOWN", "UNKNOWN_ENTITY",
        [Known Contract Count] = 0, "NO_KNOWN_SUPPLIERS",
        [Contract Value COP] = 0, "ZERO_TOTAL_VALUE",
        [Known Value COP] = 0, "ZERO_KNOWN_VALUE",
        [Count Identity Coverage] < 1 || [Value Identity Coverage] < 1, "INSUFFICIENT_IDENTITY_COVERAGE",
        "AVAILABLE"
    )
description: Gold null-reason priority plus explicit UI date, entity-selection and policy-mismatch states. Threshold equality qualifies.

name: HHI
expression:
VAR _Mode = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'DateMode'[mode], "ALL" )
VAR _Start = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'DateStart'[Date] )
VAR _End = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'DateEnd'[Date] )
VAR _Reference =
    FILTER (
        CALCULATETABLE ( 'mart_contract_detail', REMOVEFILTERS ( 'dim_supplier' ) ),
        _Mode = "ALL"
            || ( _Mode = "MISSING" && ISBLANK ( 'mart_contract_detail'[signing_date] ) )
            || ( _Mode = "INTERVAL" && NOT ISBLANK ( 'mart_contract_detail'[signing_date] )
                && 'mart_contract_detail'[signing_date] >= _Start && 'mart_contract_detail'[signing_date] < _End )
    )
VAR _Known = FILTER ( _Reference, 'mart_contract_detail'[supplier_identity_status] = "KNOWN" )
VAR _SupplierValues = GROUPBY ( _Known, 'mart_contract_detail'[supplier_sk], "__Value", SUMX ( CURRENTGROUP (), 'mart_contract_detail'[contract_value_cop] ) )
VAR _Denominator = [Known Value COP]
RETURN
    IF ( [HHI State] = "AVAILABLE", SUMX ( _SupplierValues, POWER ( DIVIDE ( [__Value], _Denominator ), 2 ) ) )
description: Pooled supplier sums across the selected months; sum of squared known-value shares on scale0–1. Never averages monthly HHI.

name: HHI Display
expression:
VAR _ImportState = [Import State]
RETURN SWITCH ( _ImportState,
    "NO_VALID_IMPORT", "Sin Import válido; ejecuta un refresh completo para cargar la publicación.",
    "INCONSISTENT_IMPORT", "Import inconsistente; ejecuta un refresh completo. Si persiste, reconstruye el modelo desde una publicación verificada.",
    IF ( [HHI State] = "AVAILABLE", FORMAT ( [HHI], "0.000", "es-CO" ), "No disponible" )
)
description: Short numeric card; pair with HHI State Label for reason.

VAR _End = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'DateEnd'[Date] )
VAR _Reference =
    FILTER (
        CALCULATETABLE ( 'mart_contract_detail', REMOVEFILTERS ( 'dim_supplier' ) ),
        _Mode = "ALL"
            || ( _Mode = "MISSING" && ISBLANK ( 'mart_contract_detail'[signing_date] ) )
            || ( _Mode = "INTERVAL" && NOT ISBLANK ( 'mart_contract_detail'[signing_date] )
                && 'mart_contract_detail'[signing_date] >= _Start && 'mart_contract_detail'[signing_date] < _End )
    )
VAR _SupplierRows = FILTER ( _Reference, 'mart_contract_detail'[supplier_identity_status] = "KNOWN" && CONTAINS ( _RowSuppliers, 'dim_supplier'[supplier_sk], 'mart_contract_detail'[supplier_sk] ) )
RETURN
    IF ( [Selection State] = "AVAILABLE" && COUNTROWS ( _SupplierRows ) > 0, COUNTROWS ( SUMMARIZE ( _SupplierRows, 'mart_contract_detail'[contract_key] ) ) )
description: Known supplier row value/count, independent of disconnected focus. Unknown rows stay blank; table sorting must use value then stable supplier key.

name: Ranking Supplier Share
expression: DIVIDE ( [Ranking Supplier Value COP], [Known Value COP] )
description: Known supplier row value / full reference known value; denominator never truncated to top10.

name: Supplier Row Selected
expression:
IF ( ISFILTERED ( 'SupplierFocus' ) && HASONEVALUE ( 'SupplierFocus'[supplier_sk] )
        && HASONEVALUE ( 'dim_supplier'[supplier_sk] )
        && SELECTEDVALUE ( 'SupplierFocus'[supplier_sk] ) = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'dim_supplier'[supplier_sk] ), 1, 0 )
description: Highlight indicator for ranking rows; accompany color with selected-row text.

name: Scope Label
expression:
VAR _From = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'publication_metadata'[scope_signing_from] )
VAR _To = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'publication_metadata'[scope_signing_to] )
VAR _StartDate = IF ( ISBLANK ( _From ) || LEN ( _From ) <> 10, BLANK (), IFERROR ( DATE ( VALUE ( LEFT ( _From, 4 ) ), VALUE ( MID ( _From, 6, 2 ) ), VALUE ( RIGHT ( _From, 2 ) ) ), BLANK () ) )
VAR _EndDate = IF ( ISBLANK ( _To ) || LEN ( _To ) <> 10, BLANK (), IFERROR ( DATE ( VALUE ( LEFT ( _To, 4 ) ), VALUE ( MID ( _To, 6, 2 ) ), VALUE ( RIGHT ( _To, 2 ) ) ), BLANK () ) )
VAR _Missing = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'publication_metadata'[scope_missing_signing] )
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _StartDate ) || ISBLANK ( _EndDate ), "Registro en Antioquia. Periodo de firma e inclusión de fechas ausentes sin documentar.", "Registro en Antioquia. Firma: " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _StartDate ), "inicio sin definir", FORMAT ( _StartDate, "d mmm yyyy", "es-CO" ) ) & " a " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _EndDate ), "fin sin definir", FORMAT ( _EndDate, "d mmm yyyy", "es-CO" ) ) & " (fin excluido). " & IF ( _Missing = "excluded", "Sin fecha excluidos.", "Sin fecha: " & COALESCE ( _Missing, "sin definir" ) ) )
description: Frozen publication scope, not current slicer interval or execution geography.

name: Coverage Label
expression:
VAR _Known = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'publication_metadata'[coverage_known], FALSE () )
VAR _State = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'publication_metadata'[coverage_state] )
RETURN
    IF ( NOT _Known, "Cobertura no determinada",
        SWITCH ( _State, "sample", "Muestra", "partial", "Parcial", "complete", "Completa dentro del alcance", "Cobertura no determinada" ) )
description: Coverage label is independent of contract filters and never claims complete national/regional contracting.

name: Import Label
expression:
VAR _ImportState = [Import State]
RETURN SWITCH ( _ImportState,
    "NO_VALID_IMPORT", "Sin Import válido; ejecuta un refresh completo para cargar la publicación.",
    "INCONSISTENT_IMPORT", "Import inconsistente; ejecuta un refresh completo. Si persiste, reconstruye el modelo desde una publicación verificada.",
    VAR _Started = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'ImportContext'[import_started_at_utc] )
VAR _Observed = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'publication_metadata'[observed_at_utc] )
RETURN "Datos: " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _Observed ), "No disponible", FORMAT ( _Observed, "d mmm yyyy, HH:mm", "es-CO" ) & " (UTC)" ) & UNICHAR ( 10 ) & "Carga: " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _Started ), "No disponible", FORMAT ( _Started, "d mmm yyyy, HH:mm", "es-CO" ) & " (UTC)" )
)
description: Frozen published observation clock and successful loaded Import start; neither is live freshness or completion.

name: Selection Label
expression:
VAR _ImportState = [Import State]
RETURN SWITCH ( _ImportState,
    "NO_VALID_IMPORT", "Sin Import válido; ejecuta un refresh completo para cargar la publicación.",
    "INCONSISTENT_IMPORT", "Import inconsistente; ejecuta un refresh completo. Si persiste, reconstruye el modelo desde una publicación verificada.",
    VAR _Mode = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'DateMode'[mode], "ALL" )
VAR _Entity = IF ( NOT ISFILTERED ( 'dim_entity' ), "Todas las entidades", SELECTEDVALUE ( 'dim_entity'[entity_name], "Varias entidades" ) )
VAR _Dates = SWITCH ( _Mode,
    "MISSING", "Solo sin firma",
    "INTERVAL", FORMAT ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'DateStart'[Date] ), "d mmm yyyy", "es-CO" ) & " ≤ firma < " & FORMAT ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'DateEnd'[Date] ), "d mmm yyyy", "es-CO" ),
    "Todas las firmas de la publicación; incluye ausentes" )
VAR _Focus = IF ( NOT ISFILTERED ( 'SupplierFocus' ), "Sin proveedor destacado", SELECTEDVALUE ( 'SupplierFocus'[supplier_label], "Selección de proveedor inválida" ) )
RETURN
    IF ( [Selection State] <> "AVAILABLE", "Revise el modo y el intervalo de firma", _Entity & "; " & _Dates & "; " & _Focus )
)
description: Date and supplier context in Spanish; all-date mode only includes records within the already published population.

name: Global Input Observations

VAR _Control = FILTER ( ALL ( 'mart_data_quality' ), 'mart_data_quality'[control_id] = "input_observations" && 'mart_data_quality'[evaluation_grain] = "OBSERVATION" )
RETURN
    IF ( COUNTROWS ( _Control ) = 1 && MAXX ( _Control, 'mart_data_quality'[control_state] ) = "AVAILABLE", MAXX ( _Control, 'mart_data_quality'[numerator] ) )
description: Global publication evidence, unaffected by contract filters. Missing/legacy counters remain blank rather than zero; population is declared by the source control.

name: Global Accepted Observations
expression:
VAR _Control = FILTER ( ALL ( 'mart_data_quality' ), 'mart_data_quality'[control_id] = "accepted_valid_observations" && 'mart_data_quality'[evaluation_grain] = "OBSERVATION" )
RETURN
    IF ( COUNTROWS ( _Control ) = 1 && MAXX ( _Control, 'mart_data_quality'[control_state] ) = "AVAILABLE", MAXX ( _Control, 'mart_data_quality'[numerator] ) )

expression:

expression:

    IF ( COUNTROWS ( _Control ) = 1 && MAXX ( _Control, 'mart_data_quality'[control_state] ) = "AVAILABLE", MAXX ( _Control, 'mart_data_quality'[numerator] ) )

name: Global Superseded Observations
expression:

RETURN
    IF ( COUNTROWS ( _Control ) = 1 && MAXX ( _Control, 'mart_data_quality'[control_state] ) = "AVAILABLE", MAXX ( _Control, 'mart_data_quality'[numerator] ) )

name: Global Output Contracts
expression:
VAR _Control = FILTER ( ALL ( 'mart_data_quality' ), 'mart_data_quality'[control_id] = "output_contracts" && 'mart_data_quality'[evaluation_grain] = "OBSERVATION" )
RETURN
    IF ( COUNTROWS ( _Control ) = 1 && MAXX ( _Control, 'mart_data_quality'[control_state] ) = "AVAILABLE", MAXX ( _Control, 'mart_data_quality'[numerator] ) )
description: Global publication evidence, unaffected by contract filters. Missing/legacy counters remain blank rather than zero; population is declared by the source control.

name: Global Observation Evidence State
expression:
VAR _Controls = FILTER ( ALL ( 'mart_data_quality' ), 'mart_data_quality'[evaluation_grain] = "OBSERVATION" )
RETURN
    SWITCH ( TRUE (),
        COUNTROWS ( _Controls ) = 0, "UNAVAILABLE",
        COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( _Controls, 'mart_data_quality'[control_state] = "UNAVAILABLE_LEGACY" ) ) > 0, "UNAVAILABLE_LEGACY",
        COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( _Controls, 'mart_data_quality'[control_state] <> "AVAILABLE" ) ) > 0, "UNAVAILABLE",
        "AVAILABLE" )
description: Evidence availability from global source controls; not a dynamic refresh-health signal.

name: Global Reconciliation State
expression:
VAR _Input = [Global Input Observations]
VAR _Accepted = [Global Accepted Observations]
VAR _Output = [Global Output Contracts]
VAR _Rejected = [Global Rejected Observations]
VAR _Duplicates = [Global Exact Duplicates]
VAR _Superseded = [Global Superseded Observations]
RETURN
    SWITCH ( TRUE (),
        ISBLANK ( _Input ) || ISBLANK ( _Accepted ) || ISBLANK ( _Output ) || ISBLANK ( _Rejected ) || ISBLANK ( _Duplicates ) || ISBLANK ( _Superseded ), "UNAVAILABLE",
        _Input = _Output + _Rejected + _Duplicates + _Superseded && _Accepted = _Input - _Rejected, "MATCH",
        "MISMATCH" )
description: Explicit observation accounting from six non-null source counters. No success inferred from refresh or absent evidence.

name: Selected Supplier Label
expression:
IF ( NOT ISFILTERED ( 'SupplierFocus' ), "Sin proveedor destacado",
        IF ( NOT HASONEVALUE ( 'SupplierFocus'[supplier_sk] ), "Selección de proveedor inválida",
            SELECTEDVALUE ( 'SupplierFocus'[supplier_label], "Identidad de proveedor no disponible" ) ) )
description: Visible disconnected supplier focus, including the explicit unknown-identity member.

name: Source Process URL
expression:
VAR _URL = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[source_process_url] )
RETURN
    IF ( HASONEVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[contract_key] )
        && SELECTEDVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[source_link_state] ) = "AVAILABLE"
        && NOT ISBLANK ( _URL ), _URL )
description: Only the existing sanitized publication URL for one contract with AVAILABLE link state. Publication enforces reviewed HTTPS/host allowlist; no URL is constructed.

name: Detail Contract Label
expression:
IF ( NOT HASONEVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[contract_key] ), "Seleccione un contrato",
    "Contrato " & COALESCE ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[contract_reference] ), "No disponible" ) & UNICHAR ( 10 ) & "ID: " & COALESCE ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[contract_id] ), "No disponible" ) & "; Proceso: " & COALESCE ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[process_id] ), "No disponible" ) )

name: Detail Entity Label

IF ( NOT HASONEVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[contract_key] ), "Seleccione un contrato",
    VAR _MunicipalityKey = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[municipality_sk] )
VAR _Municipality = LOOKUPVALUE ( 'dim_municipality'[municipality_name], 'dim_municipality'[municipality_sk], _MunicipalityKey )
RETURN COALESCE ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[entity_name] ), "Entidad sin nombre" ) & "; " & COALESCE ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[entity_code] ), "Código no disponible" ) & UNICHAR ( 10 ) & "Identidad: " & IF ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[entity_identity_status] ) = "KNOWN", "conocida", "no utilizable" ) & "; Municipio registrado: " & COALESCE ( _Municipality, "No disponible" ) )
description: Entity identity and registered municipality, not execution location.

name: Detail Supplier Label
expression:
IF ( NOT HASONEVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[contract_key] ), "Seleccione un contrato",
    COALESCE ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[supplier_name] ), "Proveedor sin nombre" ) & "; " & COALESCE ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[supplier_code] ), "Código no disponible" ) & UNICHAR ( 10 ) & IF ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[supplier_identity_status] ) = "KNOWN", "Identidad conocida", "Sin identidad de proveedor utilizable" ) )
description: Supplier name/code and explicit identity usability.

name: Detail Value Label
expression:
IF ( NOT HASONEVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[contract_key] ), "Seleccione un contrato",
    IF ( ISBLANK ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[contract_value_cop] ) ), "Valor no disponible", FORMAT ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[contract_value_cop] ), "#,0.00", "es-CO" ) & " COP" ) )

name: Detail Status Label
expression:
IF ( NOT HASONEVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[contract_key] ), "Seleccione un contrato",
    "Estado de fuente: " & COALESCE ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[status_raw] ), "Sin estado" ) & UNICHAR ( 10 ) & "Perfil: " & SWITCH ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[status_profile_state] ), "PROFILED", "catalogado", "MISSING", "sin estado", "no catalogado" ) )
description: Raw source status retained; profile state translated without treating raw states as errors.

name: Detail Dates Label
expression:
IF ( NOT HASONEVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[contract_key] ), "Seleccione un contrato",
    "Firma: " & IF ( ISBLANK ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[signing_date] ) ), "No disponible", FORMAT ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[signing_date] ), "d mmm yyyy", "es-CO" ) ) & UNICHAR ( 10 ) & "Inicio: " & IF ( ISBLANK ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[start_date] ) ), "No disponible", FORMAT ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[start_date] ), "d mmm yyyy", "es-CO" ) ) & UNICHAR ( 10 ) & "Fin: " & IF ( ISBLANK ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[end_date] ) ), "No disponible", FORMAT ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[end_date] ), "d mmm yyyy", "es-CO" ) ) )
description: Calendar dates, without invented timezone conversions.

name: Detail Observation Label
expression:
IF ( NOT HASONEVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[contract_key] ), "Seleccione un contrato",
    "Adquisición: " & IF ( ISBLANK ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[acquisition_observed_at_utc] ) ), "No disponible", FORMAT ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[acquisition_observed_at_utc] ), "d mmm yyyy, HH:mm:ss", "es-CO" ) & " UTC" ) & UNICHAR ( 10 ) & "Actualización fuente: " & IF ( ISBLANK ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[source_updated_at] ) ), "No disponible", FORMAT ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[source_updated_at] ), "d mmm yyyy, HH:mm:ss", "es-CO" ) & "; zona no declarada" ) & UNICHAR ( 10 ) & "Pipeline: " & IF ( ISBLANK ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[pipeline_completed_at_utc] ) ), "No disponible", FORMAT ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[pipeline_completed_at_utc] ), "d mmm yyyy, HH:mm:ss", "es-CO" ) & " UTC" ) )
description: Three distinct clocks; source timestamp has no declared timezone.

name: Detail Condition Label
expression:
VAR _Condition = IF ( NOT HASONEVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[contract_key] ), "Seleccione un contrato",
    SWITCH ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[condition_state] ), "LATER_INVALID_OBSERVED", "Versión válida retenida: se observó después una versión inválida atribuible. No equivale a irregularidad contractual.", "TEMPORAL_ORDER_INDETERMINATE", "Orden temporal indeterminado: no puede afirmarse cuál observación es posterior.", "LEGACY_UNASSESSED", "Histórico sin evaluación de condición: evidencia no disponible.", "NO_LATER_INVALID_OBSERVED", "Sin observación inválida posterior atribuible dentro de la evidencia disponible.", "Condición no disponible" ) )
RETURN IF ( HASONEVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[contract_key] ), _Condition & UNICHAR ( 10 ) & COALESCE ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[Condition Presentation] ), "Conteos no disponibles" ), _Condition )
description: Spanish condition reasons; no inference beyond observed evidence.

name: Detail Source State Label

IF ( NOT HASONEVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[contract_key] ), "Seleccione un contrato",
    IF ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[source_link_state] ) = "AVAILABLE" && NOT ISBLANK ( [Source Process URL] ), "Enlace del proceso disponible; abrir SECOP", "Enlace del proceso no disponible o no permitido" ) )
description: Source-link availability only; existing Source Process URL is never reconstructed.

name: Detail Publication Label

IF ( NOT HASONEVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[contract_key] ), "Seleccione un contrato",
    "Publicación: " & COALESCE ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[publication_id] ), "No disponible" ) & UNICHAR ( 10 ) & "Versión Silver: " & COALESCE ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[silver_version_id] ), "No disponible" ) )

expression:

RETURN SWITCH ( _ImportState,

    "INCONSISTENT_IMPORT", "Import inconsistente; ejecuta un refresh completo. Si persiste, reconstruye el modelo desde una publicación verificada.",
    SWITCH ( [HHI State],
"AVAILABLE", "Disponible: identidad conocida cubre el 100 % de contratos y valor observado.",
"NO_CONTRACTS", "No disponible: no hay contratos en la referencia seleccionada.",

"UNKNOWN_ENTITY", "No disponible: la entidad no tiene identidad utilizable.",
"NO_KNOWN_SUPPLIERS", "No disponible: no hay proveedores con identidad conocida.",
"ZERO_TOTAL_VALUE", "No disponible: el valor total observado es cero.",
"ZERO_KNOWN_VALUE", "No disponible: el valor de proveedores conocidos es cero.",
"INSUFFICIENT_IDENTITY_COVERAGE", "No disponible: la identidad conocida no cubre el 100 % de contratos y valor observado.",
"POLICY_UNCONFIGURED", "No disponible: falta la política de concentración publicada.",
"POLICY_MISMATCH", "No disponible: la política publicada no coincide con la versión revisada.",
"INVALID_DATE_MODE", "Seleccione un solo modo de fechas.",
"INVALID_DATE_INTERVAL", "Seleccione inicio y fin exclusivo; el inicio debe ser anterior al fin.",
"Estado de concentración no disponible" )
)

name: Coverage Summary Label
expression:
VAR _Summary = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'publication_metadata'[coverage_summary] )
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _Summary ) || _Summary = "", "Resumen de cobertura no disponible", SUBSTITUTE ( _Summary, " · ", "; " ) )
description: Published acquisition coverage summary; unavailable remains explicit.

name: Import State
expression:
VAR _Metadata = ALL ( 'publication_metadata' )
VAR _Context = ALL ( 'ImportContext' )
VAR _MetadataCount = COUNTROWS ( _Metadata )
VAR _ContextCount = COUNTROWS ( _Context )
VAR _MetadataID = MAXX ( _Metadata, 'publication_metadata'[publication_id] )
VAR _ContextID = MAXX ( _Context, 'ImportContext'[publication_id] )
RETURN SWITCH ( TRUE (),
    _MetadataCount = 0 && _ContextCount = 0, "NO_VALID_IMPORT",
    _MetadataCount = 1 && _ContextCount = 1
        && NOT ISBLANK ( _MetadataID ) && _MetadataID <> ""
        && NOT ISBLANK ( _ContextID ) && _ContextID <> ""
        && _MetadataID = _ContextID, "AVAILABLE",
    "INCONSISTENT_IMPORT" )
description: Frozen imported metadata/context identity consistency. Valid empty publication remains available; no wall-clock or descriptor-expiry test.

name: Global Input Display
expression:
VAR _Count = [Global Input Observations]
RETURN IF ( [Import State] = "AVAILABLE" && NOT ISBLANK ( _Count ), FORMAT ( _Count, "#,0", "es-CO" ) & " observaciones" )
description: Snapshot-wide count with explicit unit; unavailable imported evidence stays blank.

name: Global Output Display
expression:
VAR _Count = [Global Output Contracts]
RETURN IF ( [Import State] = "AVAILABLE" && NOT ISBLANK ( _Count ), FORMAT ( _Count, "#,0", "es-CO" ) & " contratos" )
description: Snapshot-wide count with explicit unit; unavailable imported evidence stays blank.

name: Global Accepted Display

VAR _Count = [Global Accepted Observations]
VAR _Input = [Global Input Observations]
RETURN IF ( [Import State] = "AVAILABLE" && NOT ISBLANK ( _Count ) && NOT ISBLANK ( _Input ), FORMAT ( _Count, "#,0", "es-CO" ) & " / " & FORMAT ( _Input, "#,0", "es-CO" ) & " observaciones de entrada" )
description: Snapshot-wide numerator / input-observation denominator; unavailable evidence stays blank, including legacy.

description: Snapshot-wide numerator / input-observation denominator; unavailable evidence stays blank, including legacy.

name: Global Duplicates Display
expression:

VAR _Input = [Global Input Observations]
RETURN IF ( [Import State] = "AVAILABLE" && NOT ISBLANK ( _Count ) && NOT ISBLANK ( _Input ), FORMAT ( _Count, "#,0", "es-CO" ) & " / " & FORMAT ( _Input, "#,0", "es-CO" ) & " observaciones de entrada" )
description: Snapshot-wide numerator / input-observation denominator; unavailable evidence stays blank, including legacy.

name: Global Superseded Display
expression:
VAR _Count = [Global Superseded Observations]
VAR _Input = [Global Input Observations]
RETURN IF ( [Import State] = "AVAILABLE" && NOT ISBLANK ( _Count ) && NOT ISBLANK ( _Input ), FORMAT ( _Count, "#,0", "es-CO" ) & " / " & FORMAT ( _Input, "#,0", "es-CO" ) & " observaciones de entrada" )
description: Snapshot-wide numerator / input-observation denominator; unavailable evidence stays blank, including legacy.

name: Global Quality Label
expression:
SWITCH ( TRUE (),
    [Import State] = "NO_VALID_IMPORT", "Sin Import válido; ejecuta un refresh completo para cargar la publicación.",
    [Import State] <> "AVAILABLE", "Import inconsistente; ejecuta un refresh completo desde una publicación verificada.",
    [Global Observation Evidence State] = "UNAVAILABLE_LEGACY", "Histórico sin evidencia de observaciones; no es posible reconciliar los conteos.",
    [Global Observation Evidence State] <> "AVAILABLE", "Evidencia global de observaciones no disponible; no es posible reconciliar los conteos.",
    [Global Reconciliation State] = "MATCH", "Conteos reconciliados: entrada = contratos + rechazadas + duplicadas + sustituidas; aceptadas = entrada − rechazadas.",
    [Global Reconciliation State] = "MISMATCH", "Conteos no reconciliados: las ecuaciones de observaciones no coinciden. Requiere revisión de la publicación.",
    "Reconciliación no disponible: falta al menos un conteo de observaciones." )
description: Spanish evidence and reconciliation status; independent of successful refresh claims.

name: Supplier Focus Count Display

VAR _Value = [Selected Supplier Contract Count]
RETURN IF ( [Import State] = "AVAILABLE" && ISFILTERED ( 'SupplierFocus' ) && HASONEVALUE ( 'SupplierFocus'[supplier_sk] ) && NOT ISBLANK ( _Value ), FORMAT ( _Value, "#,0", "es-CO" ) & " contratos" )

name: Supplier Focus Value Display
expression:
VAR _Value = [Selected Supplier Value COP]
RETURN IF ( [Import State] = "AVAILABLE" && ISFILTERED ( 'SupplierFocus' ) && HASONEVALUE ( 'SupplierFocus'[supplier_sk] ) && NOT ISBLANK ( _Value ), FORMAT ( _Value, "#,0.00", "es-CO" ) & " COP" )
description: Only an explicit singleton disconnected supplier focus is presented; reference fallback is not shown as focus.

name: Supplier Focus Share Display
expression:
VAR _Share = [Selected Supplier Share]
RETURN IF ( [Import State] = "AVAILABLE" && ISFILTERED ( 'SupplierFocus' ) && HASONEVALUE ( 'SupplierFocus'[supplier_sk] ) && NOT ISBLANK ( _Share ), FORMAT ( _Share, "0.00%", "es-CO" ) )
description: Display a known supplier share only after an explicit single supplier focus; no-focus and unknown identity remain blank.

name: Median Value Display
expression:
VAR _Value = [Median Value COP]
VAR _Format = IF ( _Value = TRUNC ( _Value ), "#,0", IF ( _Value = ROUND ( _Value, 2 ), "#,0.00", "#,0.0000" ) )
RETURN IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( _Value ), FORMAT ( _Value, _Format, "es-CO" ) & " COP" )
description: Exact median presentation in Colombian notation, without automatic scaling; integer values have no decimal tail, half-cent results retain four decimals.

name: Detail Evidence Label
expression: IF ( NOT HASONEVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[contract_key] ), "Seleccione un contrato", COALESCE ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[Evidence Presentation] ), "Evidencia no disponible" ) )
description: Allowlisted published evidence parsed as structured JSON in M; all links retained at one contract grain, no raw payload or paths.

name: Detail Identity Reasons Label
expression:
VAR _Entity = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[entity_identity_reason] )
VAR _Supplier = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[supplier_identity_reason] )
VAR _EntityText = SWITCH ( _Entity, "LEGACY_PROJECTION", "proyección histórica sin código evaluable", "MISSING_CODE", "código ausente", "PLACEHOLDER_CODE", "código marcador no utilizable", "INVALID_CODE", "formato de código inválido", IF ( ISBLANK ( _Entity ), IF ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[entity_identity_status] ) = "KNOWN", "identidad conocida por código", "motivo no disponible" ), "Motivo publicado: " & _Entity ) )
VAR _SupplierText = SWITCH ( _Supplier, "LEGACY_PROJECTION", "proyección histórica sin código evaluable", "MISSING_CODE", "código ausente", "PLACEHOLDER_CODE", "código marcador no utilizable", "INVALID_CODE", "formato de código inválido", IF ( ISBLANK ( _Supplier ), IF ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[supplier_identity_status] ) = "KNOWN", "identidad conocida por código", "motivo no disponible" ), "Motivo publicado: " & _Supplier ) )
RETURN IF ( NOT HASONEVALUE ( 'mart_contract_detail'[contract_key] ), "Seleccione un contrato", "Entidad: " & _EntityText & UNICHAR ( 10 ) & "Proveedor: " & _SupplierText )
description: Reason translations from platform-code-v1; no name-based identity inference.

name: Date Mode Label
expression:
VAR _Mode = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'DateMode'[mode], "ALL" )
RETURN IF ( ISFILTERED ( 'DateMode' ) && NOT HASONEVALUE ( 'DateMode'[mode] ), "Seleccione un modo de fechas", SELECTEDVALUE ( 'DateMode'[mode_label], IF ( _Mode = "ALL", "Todas las fechas", "Modo de fechas no disponible" ) ) )
description: Safe scalar Spanish mode label; absent selection means ALL, ambiguous selections remain explicit.

name: Reference Context Label
expression:
IF ( [Import State] <> "AVAILABLE", [Import Label],
    "Referencia R | " & IF ( NOT ISFILTERED ( 'dim_entity' ), "Todas las entidades", SELECTEDVALUE ( 'dim_entity'[Entity Label], "Varias entidades" ) )
    & " | " & [Date Mode Label]
    & IF ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'DateMode'[mode], "ALL" ) = "INTERVAL", " | " & FORMAT ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'DateStart'[Date] ), "d mmm yyyy", "es-CO" ) & " ≤ firma < " & FORMAT ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'DateEnd'[Date] ), "d mmm yyyy", "es-CO" ), "" )
 )
description: Read-only reference entity/date context; distinguishes R from disconnected supplier focus.

name: Supplier Context Label
description: Read-only disconnected supplier context without changing reference math.

name: Unknown Supplier Value COP
expression: IF ( [Selection State] = "AVAILABLE", CURRENCY ( [Contract Value COP] - [Known Value COP] ) )
description: Observed reference COP with unusable supplier identity; total less known value preserves identical R filters.

name: Reference Context Full Label
expression:
VAR _Entity = IF ( NOT ISFILTERED ( 'dim_entity' ), "Todas", CONCATENATEX ( VALUES ( 'dim_entity'[Entity Label] ), 'dim_entity'[Entity Label], "; ", 'dim_entity'[Entity Label], ASC ) )
VAR _Municipality = IF ( NOT ISFILTERED ( 'dim_municipality' ), "Todos", CONCATENATEX ( VALUES ( 'dim_municipality'[Municipality Label] ), 'dim_municipality'[Municipality Label], "; ", 'dim_municipality'[Municipality Label], ASC ) )
VAR _Modality = IF ( NOT ISFILTERED ( 'dim_modality' ), "Todas", CONCATENATEX ( VALUES ( 'dim_modality'[Modality Label] ), 'dim_modality'[Modality Label], "; ", 'dim_modality'[Modality Label], ASC ) )
VAR _Status = IF ( NOT ISFILTERED ( 'mart_contract_detail'[Status Label] ) && NOT ISFILTERED ( 'mart_contract_detail'[status_raw] ), "Todos", CONCATENATEX ( VALUES ( 'mart_contract_detail'[Status Label] ), 'mart_contract_detail'[Status Label], "; ", 'mart_contract_detail'[Status Label], ASC ) )
VAR _Mode = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'DateMode'[mode], "ALL" )
VAR _Dates = [Date Mode Label] & IF ( _Mode = "INTERVAL", " | Inicio inclusivo: " & IF ( HASONEVALUE ( 'DateStart'[Date] ), FORMAT ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'DateStart'[Date] ), "d mmm yyyy", "es-CO" ), "Seleccione una fecha" ) & " | Fin exclusivo: " & IF ( HASONEVALUE ( 'DateEnd'[Date] ), FORMAT ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'DateEnd'[Date] ), "d mmm yyyy", "es-CO" ), "Seleccione una fecha" ), "" )
RETURN IF ( [Import State] <> "AVAILABLE", [Import Label],
    "Referencia R" & UNICHAR ( 10 ) & "Entidades: " & COALESCE ( _Entity, "Sin valores visibles" )
    & UNICHAR ( 10 ) & "Municipios de registro: " & COALESCE ( _Municipality, "Sin valores visibles" )
    & UNICHAR ( 10 ) & "Modalidades: " & COALESCE ( _Modality, "Sin valores visibles" )
    & UNICHAR ( 10 ) & "Estados observados: " & COALESCE ( _Status, "Sin valores visibles" )
    & UNICHAR ( 10 ) & "Fechas: " & _Dates )
description: Read-only full selected R labels with date bounds. Lists are untruncated for wrapped scrolling presentation; not a fact population count.

name: Contract Value Display
expression:
VAR _Value = [Contract Value COP]
RETURN IF ( [Import State] = "AVAILABLE" && NOT ISBLANK ( _Value ), FORMAT ( _Value, "#,0.00", "es-CO" ) & " COP" )
description: Exact backend Currency formatting for cards/tables; prevents client numeric-to-JavaScript precision loss. Numeric metric remains unchanged.
